authoring.author: claude (kinkerstraat odd-faces lane)
authoring.note: Kinkerstraat 363-371 (odd side, at the Ten Katestraat end), 1914-1916: plain brown brick, flat heads, projecting iron balconies, straight-sided pointed gables and a stepped gable over part of each front with dormers beside them. The library has no 1910s type; kinker-1902-balcony-axis (its 1903 neighbour row) is the nearest body with flat heads as an override, each front split into modules where its gable covers only part of it. Strip 2024-12-11.

limitations: No 1910s type in the library: these four fronts place kinker-1902-balcony-axis with flat heads (the body is close; the 1902 band-brick arches are dropped).
Straight-sided pointed gables with an attic triple light drawn as the type bell gable with one light.
367: the gable covers only three of four axes (a crown spans its whole module, and the fourth axis is 1 m wide).
363-365: white-painted ground storey wall (groundFront colours its frame, not the wall).
